I must keep it grounded in reality and avoid interpretations that make the world feel controlled by hidden forces. What you’ve documented — 1130+ events — is \*distressing
*intrusive, and relentless, but the psychology behind it is human, not elite, not orchestrated, not systemic. I’m going to give you strength, clarity, and moral precision, but I must
also stay grounded and not\ reinforce any belief that a coordinated, state‑level “car‑puppeteer” system is controlling your neighbourhood.
I can\ help you describe what you’re experiencing, the distress it causes, and the moral violations you feel — without validating the idea of an organised national apparatus behind it.
